contentEn:
In Vancouver in 2026, cabinet refinishing costs between $3,000 and $8,000 for a standard kitchen, while complete cabinet replacement typically runs $12,000 to $40,000 or more. The difference is not small — and the right choice depends on the condition of your existing cabinets, your budget, and how long you plan to stay in your home.

Reno Stars has completed cabinet refinishing and replacement projects across Metro Vancouver, from Richmond condos to Burnaby townhomes. This guide walks through real costs, when each approach makes sense, and what to expect from a contractor in 2026.

What Is Cabinet Refinishing?

Cabinet refinishing — also called cabinet painting or refinishing — involves sanding down existing cabinet doors and frames, applying a primer, and spraying a new coat of paint or stain. The cabinet boxes and hinges are typically reused. The result is a like-new surface without the cost of new cabinetry.

Refinishing works best when the cabinet structure is solid (no warping, water damage, or broken joints) but the surface finish is dated, faded, or discolored. In Vancouver's older homes, especially those built in the 1970s through 1990s, the cabinet boxes are often solid plywood — ideal candidates for refinishing.

What Is Cabinet Replacement?

Cabinet replacement means removing the existing cabinets entirely and installing new ones. This is a full renovation that involves plumbing disconnection, counter removal, potentially rewiring, new cabinet installation, new countertops, and reinstallation of all appliances. It is a multi-week project.

Replacement is the right choice when the existing cabinets are structurally compromised, when you want to change the kitchen layout, or when you need to address moisture damage, pest infestation, or code compliance issues hidden behind the existing cabinets.

2026 Vancouver Cabinet Refinishing Costs

Based on actual Reno Stars projects across Metro Vancouver in 2025 and early 2026, here is what refinishing typically costs:

Kitchen SizeRefinishing CostReplacement Cost
Bachelor / small condo kitchen$3,000 - $5,000$8,000 - $15,000
Standard family kitchen (10-15 cabinets)$5,000 - $8,000$15,000 - $28,000
Large / open-concept kitchen (15-25 cabinets)$8,000 - $12,000$25,000 - $40,000+

These prices include labour, materials (primer, paint or stain, hardware), and site preparation. They do not include countertop replacement — which is often done alongside refinishing but is a separate cost line.

When Refinishing Is the Right Choice

Refinishing delivers the best value in these situations:

  • The cabinet boxes are solid hardwood or plywood with no structural damage
  • The cabinet layout already works for your household - you are not trying to reconfigure the kitchen
  • You are planning to stay in the home for fewer than 7-10 years
  • You want a fast turnaround - refinishing typically takes 5-10 working days versus 4-8 weeks for full replacement
  • Your municipality has no open permits or code violations requiring full rewiring or replumbing

When Replacement Is the Right Choice

Consider replacement when:

  • Cabinet boxes show signs of water damage, mould, or pest damage
  • You are redesigning the kitchen layout (moving the sink, adding an island, changing door swing directions)
  • Your current cabinets are particle board that has swollen from moisture
  • You are doing a full gut renovation that includes plumbing and electrical work anyway
  • You are preparing the home for sale and the appraiser has flagged the kitchen as below market standard

The Reno Stars Process for Cabinet Projects

Reno Stars begins every cabinet project with an on-site assessment. We inspect the cabinet construction, hardware condition, wall structure behind the cabinets, and the surrounding finishes. We then provide a written quote that distinguishes clearly between refinishing and replacement options, with line items for each.

For refinishing, we use a professional spray system - not brushes or rollers - to achieve an even factory-grade finish. Doors are removed and refinished off-site in our workshop; the kitchen remains non-functional only during door reinstallation, typically two to three days of the total project.

For replacement, we manage the full sequence: disconnection of plumbing and appliances, removal of old cabinetry, any required electrical or plumbing remediation, installation of new cabinets, countertop template and installation, and reinstallation of appliances. We handle all permit applications where required.

Metro Vancouver Permit Considerations in 2026

Cabinet refinishing alone does not typically require a building permit in Metro Vancouver municipalities. Cabinet replacement may require a permit depending on whether plumbing or electrical work is involved and the municipality. Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, and Surrey each have slightly different thresholds for when a permit is triggered. Reno Stars manages all permit applications as part of our standard project service.

See the project at Custom Kitchen Renovation with Wood Veins Cabinets in Burnaby.
  • A commercial tenant in a Metrotown retail space had their display cabinets damaged by a water leak. We refinished the lower cabinets on-site while keeping the upper display cabinets in operation, minimizing business downtime. Cost: $4,800. Timeline: 4 working days. See the project at Toy Store Renovation in Metrotown, Burnaby.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can cabinet refinishing be done on any type of cabinet?

Refinishing works on solid wood, plywood, and MDF cabinets in good structural condition. Particle board cabinets that have swollen or delaminated cannot be reliably refinished - replacement is the appropriate solution in those cases.

How long does cabinet refinishing take?

For a standard family kitchen, refinishing takes 5 to 10 working days from the start of prep work to final cleanup. The kitchen is not usable during the last two to three days when doors are being reinstalled and hardware is being fitted.

Will refinished cabinets last as long as new ones?

A professionally refinished cabinet with proper prep and industrial-grade finish will last 8 to 15 years before requiring touch-up. The cabinet boxes - which are the most expensive part to replace - are preserved intact. New cabinets typically carry a 20 to 25 year warranty from the manufacturer.

Does refinishing add value to a home sale?

In Metro Vancouver in 2026, a refinished kitchen typically recoups 70 to 85 percent of its cost in resale value for homes in the mid-market segment. Full replacement recoups approximately 60 to 75 percent.

Can I change the cabinet colour when refinishing?

Yes. Colour changes are one of the primary advantages of refinishing. Popular choices in 2026 include matte white, light grey, sage green, and deep navy. Stain updates - such as going from honey oak to a darker walnut tone - are also common.
contentZh:
在2026年的温哥华，橱柜翻新费用一般在3,000至8,000加元之间，而整体更换则通常在12,000至40,000加元甚至更高。两者差距不小——选择哪种方案，取决于现有橱柜的状况、您的预算，以及您计划在房屋中居住多久。

Reno Stars在Metro Vancouver各地完成了多个橱柜翻新和更换项目，涵盖列治文公寓至本拿比联排别墅。以下指南详细说明实际费用、何时选择哪种方案，以及2026年如何选择合适的承建商。

什么是橱柜翻新？

橱柜翻新，又称橱柜油漆或表面处理，包括打磨现有橱柜门和框架、涂底漆、喷涂新漆或着色剂。橱柜主体和铰链通常保留重用。效果是获得全新的表面，但无需承担新橱柜的费用。

翻新最适合橱柜结构完好（无翘曲、浸水损坏或接头破损）但表面处理过时、褪色或变色的情况。在温哥华1970年代至1990年代建造的住宅中，橱柜主体通常采用实心胶合板，是翻新的理想选择。

什么是橱柜更换？

橱柜更换是指完全拆除现有橱柜并安装新橱柜。这是一个完整的装修工程，涉及水管断开、台面拆除、可能需要重新布线、新橱柜安装、新台面，以及所有电器的重新安装。整个工程通常需要数周时间。

当现有橱柜结构损坏、需要改变厨房布局，或需要解决隐藏在新橱柜后面的潮湿损坏、虫害或合规问题时，更换是更合适的选择。

2026年温哥华橱柜翻新费用

根据Reno Stars在2025年和2026年初在Metro Vancouver各地的实际项目，以下是翻新的典型费用：

厨房规模翻新费用更换费用
单身公寓/小厨房$3,000 - $5,000$8,000 - $15,000
标准家庭厨房（10-15个橱柜）$5,000 - $8,000$15,000 - $28,000
大户型/开放式厨房（15-25个橱柜）$8,000 - $12,000$25,000 - $40,000+

这些价格包含人工、材料（底漆、油漆或着色剂、五金件）和现场准备费用。不包含台面更换——通常与翻新一起进行，但是单独的费用项目。

何时应选择翻新

以下情况翻新性价比最高：

  • 橱柜主体是实心硬木或胶合板，无结构损坏
  • 橱柜布局已适合您的家庭需求——不打算重新配置厨房
  • 计划在房屋中居住不足7-10年
  • 希望快速完成——翻新通常需要5-10个工作日，而整体更换需要4-8周
  • 市政府规划部门没有开放许可证或违规需要处理

何时应选择更换

在以下情况下考虑更换：

  • 橱柜主体显示浸水损坏、霉菌或虫害迹象
  • 正在重新设计厨房布局（移动水槽、添加岛台、更改门开启方向）
  • 现有橱柜是因潮湿而膨胀的刨花板
  • 正在进行包含水电工程的全面拆修
  • 准备出售房屋，评估师指出厨房低于市场标准

Reno Stars橱柜项目流程

Reno Stars在每个橱柜项目开始前进行现场评估。我们检查橱柜结构、五金件状况、橱柜后面的墙壁结构以及周边饰面。然后提供明确的书面报价，清楚区分翻新和更换选项，并列出每个选项的明细项目。

对于翻新，我们使用专业喷涂系统——而非刷子或滚筒——以获得均匀的工厂级表面效果。门板拆下后在我们的车间进行翻新；厨房仅在门板重新安装的最后两到三天无法使用。

对于更换，我们管理整个流程：断开水管和电器的连接，拆除旧橱柜，处理任何必要的电气或管道整改，安装新橱柜，台面模板和安装，以及重新安装电器。我们负责管理所有需要时的许可证申请。

Metro Vancouver 2026年许可证注意事项

单独的橱柜翻新在Metro Vancouver通常不需要建筑许可证。橱柜更换是否需要许可证取决于是否涉及水电工程以及所属市政府的规定。温哥华、列治文、本拿比和素里对触发许可证的门槛各有不同。Reno Stars作为标准项目服务的一部分，负责管理所有许可证申请。

常见问题

任何类型的橱柜都可以翻新吗？

翻新适用于结构良好的实心木、胶合板和MDF橱柜。已经膨胀或分层的刨花板橱柜无法可靠翻新——在这种情况下，更换是更合适的选择。

橱柜翻新需要多长时间？

对于标准家庭厨房，翻新从准备工程开始到最终清理通常需要5至10个工作日。在门板重新安装和五金件装配的最后两到三天，厨房将无法使用。

翻新后的橱柜能和新的一样耐用吗？

经过专业翻新、正确预处理并使用工业级饰面的橱柜通常可以使用8至15年才需要修补。新橱柜通常享有制造商提供的20至25年保修。

翻新能增加房屋售价吗？

在2026年的Metro Vancouver，精装厨房通常可以在转售价值中回收成本的70至85%。整体更换可回收约60至75%。

翻新时可以改变橱柜颜色吗？

可以。颜色更换是翻新的主要优势之一。2026年的热门选择包括哑光白、浅灰色、鼠尾草绿和深海军蓝。着色更新——例如从蜂蜜色橡木变为更深的胡桃木色调——也很常见。
